duration.text: The Sporting Economics and Management at Southwestern University of Finance and Economics is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2881 USD/per year ￥ 20750 CNY/per year

materials.text: Certificate of HSK HSK Level 6 or higher. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents List of academic/research productions Please give the details, if any. Certificate/diploma of highest education MUST be notarized by Chinese Embassy/Consulate General in your home country. Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Academic transcript of highest education

requirements.text: Have attained a Bachelor's Degree or equivalent, HSK 6 or above, obey Chinese laws, and without fatal health problems.
